generate_statement: generate a consensus statement from jury opinions using chain-of-thought reasoning with an LLM client
generate_opinion_critique_prompt: generate a prompt that incorporates opinions, a previous draft, and critiques for consensus refinement
generate_opinion_only_prompt: generate a prompt from jury opinions to produce an initial draft consensus statement
process_model_response: process an LLM response by extracting the consensus statement and reasoning from XML-style tags
generate_prompt: generate an LLM prompt from opinions with optional previous winner and critiques for iterative consensus building
